name: context-bridge-release
description: Mark an outbound context bridge entry as released — stop expecting replies for this outbound message. Use when a delegated conversation is complete or to clear stale context. The entry_id is shown in the [ACTIVE OUTBOUND CONTEXT] block. For task-wake bindings (context metadata bind_reply + task_id), pass reply with the CEO's answer verbatim to persist it on the originating task and release in one call.
